response.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS advanced_behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior WHERE peercorr > 0.149;

assumptions.assumption: A record qualifies only if peercorr is strictly greater than 0.149; NULL peercorr values are excluded automatically by the comparison, and records with peercorr exactly 0.149 are not counted.
The question asks for a count of rows in advancedbehavior (one row per abhvreg), not distinct counts of related trades, traders, or compliance cases.
